title: begin-base64 detection inconsistency: decode vs scan
description: decode.rs:73 checks 12 bytes (begin-base64 without trailing space). scan.rs:65 checks 13 bytes (begin-base64 with trailing space). A line 'begin-base64X 644 foo' triggers BeginBase64 from decode() but is silently skipped by scan(). Fix: align both to require the trailing space/delimiter, or document the inconsistency.
close_reason: Fixed: decode.rs begin-base64 check now requires trailing whitespace at position 12, matching scan.rs behavior.
